summary: Iteration 2 (auth + admin + authors + desk-copies + reviews) backend and frontend testing. Backend: 28/28 pytest passing covering JWT auth (register/login/me), role-based ACL (401/403/200), admin CRUD for books/orders/desk-copies, authors endpoints, reviews, /my/orders linking, invalid status validation. Frontend: admin login->/admin redirect, admin dashboard stats cards + recent orders, navigation across /admin/{books,orders,desk-copies,users}, register->/account, header account dropdown hides admin link for customers, /authors lists 6 tiles, author detail route works, book detail page + Request-a-Desk-Copy dialog submit returns success toast/done state. Minor: Review-form submission path flaked on selector wait (form not visible within 4s after clicking write-review-button — likely a state transition timing issue, not a backend failure since POST /api/books/{id}/reviews passes in pytest).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking write-review-button, [data-testid="review-form"] did not become visible within 4s in automation. May be a rendering delay; backend review POST works. Needs re-verification manually.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by the Emergent dev instrumentation injecting a <span> into <option> children. Non-blocking, present since iteration 1.

action_items: Manual verification: confirm that clicking 'Write a review' on /books/:id reveals the review form promptly (add small delay or ensure state toggles synchronously). Backend review API is verified working.
Optional: add data-testid attributes to the login error banner so automation can reliably assert wrong-credentials error text.
Optional (pre-existing): silence the <span>-in-<option> hydration warning on <select data-testid="catalog-sort"> if it is coming from Emergent dev overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: bcrypt used correctly (gensalt + checkpw); JWT secret loaded from env; admin seeder idempotent and updates password if changed.
Good: admin_router uses FastAPI dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)] centrally; all admin routes consistently 401 for missing token and 403 for non-admin.
Good: all Mongo reads project out _id and password_hash; admin users endpoint correctly strips password_hash.
Good: create_order uses get_current_user_optional so it stays open to guests while linking user_id when logged in — verified via /api/my/orders round-trip.
Minor: extensions.py is ~560 lines — acceptable, but could be split into auth/, admin/, extras/ submodules for future maintainability.
Minor: desk-copy, review, author seed logic all live in extensions.py; keeping server.py book/category seed separate from extensions.py author seed is slightly inconsistent but works.
Minor: CORS is wildcard (*) with allow_credentials=true — Starlette normalises this, but explicit origins would be safer for production.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical flows verified except review-form visibility post-click)

test_credentials: Admin admin@oakbridge.in / Oakbridge@2026 (seeded). New customers registered via /api/auth/register in tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 30 books, 5 categories, 6 authors, 1 admin user. Tests created TEST_-prefixed books/reviews/desk-copies/orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py -v. Note: email-validator rejects .test TLD; use @example.com. Catalog route is /books (not /catalog). Header testids: header-account-button + header-logout. Review form testid 'review-form' appears after clicking 'write-review-button' but timing may require >4s wait — prefer polling with longer timeout or assert by field (e.g., [data-testid="review-title"]).
rca of the issue: Minor review-form visibility timing in Playwright automation only; backend review creation + list are all passing. No actual bug observed.
